confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are informed by recent aggregated Florianópolis price references. The cocktail estimate uses the local cocktail-to-draft-beer relationship; the wine-glass estimate is inferred from local bottle-wine and beer levels. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with greater uncertainty because July demand varies.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food estimates use Florianópolis prices directly; accommodation is modeled from coastal southern Brazilian tourist markets and Florianópolis's July winter season.
